source: Polymarket Gamma (resolved binary markets) + CLOB price history — public, no credentials
purpose: The REAL-MONEY out-of-sample floor lane. This is the corpus behind the project's only committed real OOS result, and it is significantly NEGATIVE. It exists so a real (not synthetic) result reproduces offline from committed bytes.

headline_result.note: Reproduces sha256-identical offline. This is a REFUTATION, not an edge.

leakage_safety: decision-time market_price is a CLOB tick at-or-before decision_time AND strictly before resolution_time
the settled outcomePrice is NEVER used as the decision price — the fetcher RAISES rather than fabricating
zero prices at exactly 0.0 or 1.0 — the decision price is emphatically not the settled outcome
anti-leak sanity: 46 outcome=1 of which 14 priced < 0.50; 141 outcome=0 of which 9 priced > 0.50
disclosures: settled-only survivorship bias — only markets that actually resolved are present
longshot-heavy: median price 0.037 and ~58% of prices pinned below 0.05 or above 0.95, so results are dominated by the low-price extreme
cross-market same-event correlation NOT removed (this is what the per-category concentration caps exist to bound)

liquidity is null on ALL 187 records — this is deliberate and honest (Gamma's `liquidity` is a USD metric, not contract depth; mapping it would be a units fabrication), but it means the market-impact and capacity paths are INERT on this corpus and therefore untested on real data
single venue (Polymarket) and a single 7.0-day decision lead — no lead-time or venue robustness is established by this corpus alone
no wallet addresses, tokens, emails or IPs — forensically verified clean
provenance_note: Added 2026-07-25. The independent Quality Auditor flagged the absence of this sidecar under `artifact_integrity`: the corpus behind the project's only real OOS number carried no fetch date, source attribution, parameters, or bias disclosure, in contrast to the exemplary spike_corpus_politics_meta.json. Every number above is MEASURED from the committed bytes, not copied from a report.
